description: Futures market investor -- maximal single-trade spread. Can the investor (coalition) realise, on some trade, the MAXIMAL spread trade >= cap (the perfect trade: enter at 0, cash at cap), whatever the market does? Expected UNKNOWN -- soundness witness: trade = value - entry is bounded by cap, and a worst-case market denies the perfect spread by moving the value down after each reservation (the quantitative original gives a probability < 1). Per-trade companion to the cumulative-profit property <investor>F{gain >= cap}. cap is market-chosen, not fixed.
